title: Regret-Optimal Wasserstein-Robust Linear Regression
scope: Scope: Sections 2 and 3 of the manuscript, together with their required preliminary and appendix results. Later computational and finite-sample statistical results are outside this verification snapshot. Formalization of the full paper is in progress.

results.name: Lemma 1.1
results.title: Procrustes formulation of $\sB$
results.manuscript_statement_tex: \label{lem:Bures-Procrustes} For all $\bA,\bB \in \PSD^d$, we have \begin{equation*} \sB(\bA,\bB) = \min_{\bU \in \OO^d} \|\bA^{\frac{1}{2}} - \bB^{\frac{1}{2}}\bU\|_\Frob = \min_{\substack{\bS,\bT \in \R^{d \times d}\\ \bA = \bS \bS^\top\!\!, \,\bB = \bT \bT^\top}} \|\bS - \bT\|_\Frob. \end{equation*} Thus, $\sB(\bA,\bB) \leq \eps$ if and only if there exists $\bDelta \in \R^{d \times d}$ with $\|\bDelta\|_\Frob \leq \eps$ such that $\bA = (\bB^{1/2} + \bDelta)(\bB^{1/2} + \bDelta)^\top$. The minimum is attained by $\bU = \bI_d$ if $\bA$ and $\bB$ are simultaneously diagonalizable.

results.name: Lemma 1.2
results.title: $\Wtwo$--Bures equivalence
results.manuscript_statement_tex: \label{lem:W2-Bures-equivalence} For all $P \in \cP_2(\R^d)$ and $\eps \geq 0$, we have \begin{equation*} \{ \bSigma_Q : Q \in \cB_\eps(P) \} = \cB_\eps(\bSigma_P) = \left\{ (\bSigma_P^{1/2} + \bDelta)(\bSigma_P^{1/2} + \bDelta)^\top : \|\bDelta\|_\Frob \leq \eps \right\}. \end{equation*}

results.name: Theorem 2.2
results.title: Condition number formula
results.manuscript_statement_tex: \label{thm:condition-number-formula} If $P \in \cP^*$, then $R^\star_\eps(P) = \kappa_P \eps^2 + o(\eps^2)$ as $\eps \downarrow 0$ and \begin{equation*} \kappa_P = 1 + \lambda_{\max}\bigl(\bA_P \bA_P^\top + \lambda_{\min}(\bSigma_X^P)^{-1}\bSigma_E^P\,\bigr). \end{equation*} This implies the useful bounds \begin{equation*} 1 + \max\left\{\|\bA_P\|_\op^2, \frac{\lambda_{\max}(\bSigma_E^P)}{\lambda_{\min}(\bSigma_X^P)}\right\} \leq \kappa_P \leq 1 + \|\bA_P\|_\op^2 + \frac{\lambda_{\max}(\bSigma_E^P)}{\lambda_{\min}(\bSigma_X^P)}. \end{equation*}

results.name: Lemma 3.1
results.title: Regret stability
results.manuscript_statement_tex: \label{lem:regret-stability} For all $\bA \in \cA$, $P \in \cP^*$, and $Q \in \cP_2(\R^d)$, we have \begin{align*} \left|\sqrt{R(\bA,P)} - \sqrt{R(\bA,Q)}\,\right| \leq (2\sqrt{\kappa_P} + \|\bA\|_\op)\Wtwo(P,Q). \end{align*} Moreover, for $\bA = \bA_P$, we have $R(\bA_P,Q) \leq 4 \kappa_P \Wtwo(P,Q)^2$.

results.name: Lemma 3.2
results.title: Stability implications
results.manuscript_statement_tex: \label{lem:stability-implications} Let $P \in \cP^*$ and $\eps > 0$. We then have \begin{align*} R_\eps(\MRO_\eps,P) \lesssim \kappa_P \eps^2, \qquad R_\eps(\SNR_\eps,P) \lesssim \kappa_P \eps^2. \end{align*} In contrast, our ERM and DRO guarantees adapt to the largest condition number in a ball around $P$: \begin{equation*} R_\eps(\ERM,P) \lesssim \sup_{Q \in \cB_\eps(P)} \kappa_Q \eps^2 \qquad R_\eps(\DRO_\eps,P) \lesssim \sup_{Q \in \cB_{2\eps}(P)} \kappa_Q \eps^2 \end{equation*} If $\eps^2 \leq \lambda_{\min}(\bSigma_X^P)/16$, then these two upper bounds are at most $O(\kappa_P \eps^2)$.

results.name: Lemma 3.3
results.title: Rank-adaptive DRO bound
results.manuscript_statement_tex: \label{lem:DRO-rank-adaptive} For $P\in\cP^*$ and $\eps > 0$, set $r\defeq\reff(\bSigma_E^P)$. Then \[ R_\eps(\DRO_\eps,P) \lesssim \left(\sqrt{\min\{p,r\}}(\kappa_P-1) + \sqrt{r(\kappa_P-1)} + \kappa_P\right) \eps^2. \]

results.name: Theorem 3.4
results.title: Population-limit summary rates
results.manuscript_statement_tex: \label{thm:pop-limit-risk-bds} Fix $\eps > 0$ and $\kappa \geq 1$. Then the minimax rate for the class $\cG = \cG(\kappa)$ is $R_\eps^\star(\cG) \asymp \kappa \eps^2$, and this is achieved by both $\MRO_\eps$ and $\SNR_\eps$. In contrast, we have $R_\eps(\ERM,\cG) = \infty$ and \begin{equation*} R_\eps(\DRO_\eps,\cG) \asymp \left(\sqrt{\min\{p,m\}}(\kappa-1) + \sqrt{m(\kappa-1)} + \kappa\right) \eps^2. \end{equation*} In particular, if $\kappa \geq 2$ and $p \geq m$, then $R_\eps(\DRO_\eps,\cG) \asymp \sqrt{m} \kappa \eps^2$.

results.name: Lemma A.1
results.title: Basic norm and projection inequalities
results.manuscript_statement_tex: \label{lem:basic-matrix-norms} For dimension-compatible matrices, \begin{align*} \|\bA\bB\bC\|_\Frob &\leq \|\bA\|_\op\,\|\bB\|_\Frob\,\|\bC\|_\op,\\ \|\bA\bB\|_\op &\leq \|\bA\|_\op\|\bB\|_\op,\\ \|\bA\bB\|_\Frob &\leq \|\bA\|_\op\|\bB\|_\Frob,\\ \|\bA\|_\op &\leq \|\bA\|_\Frob, \qquad \|\bA\|_\Frob \leq \sqrt{\rank(\bA)}\,\|\bA\|_\op. \end{align*} If $\bPi$ is an orthogonal projection, then \begin{equation*} \|\bM\bPi\|_\Frob\leq \|\bM\|_\Frob, \qquad \|\bM\|_\Frob^2 = \|\bM\bPi\|_\Frob^2+ \|\bM(\bI-\bPi)\|_\Frob^2. \end{equation*} Finally, \begin{equation*} |\langle \bA,\bB\rangle_\Frob| \leq \|\bA\|_\Frob\|\bB\|_\Frob. \end{equation*}

results.name: Lemma A.2
results.title: Pseudoinverse and projection identities
results.manuscript_statement_tex: \label{lem:pseudoinverse-projection-facts} Let $\bM\in\R^{r\times d}$. Then $\bM^\dagger\bM$ is the orthogonal projection onto the row space of $\bM$, and $\bM\bM^\dagger$ is the orthogonal projection onto the column space of $\bM$. We always have $\bM^\dagger=\bM^\top(\bM\bM^\top)^\dagger$. If $\bM$ has full row rank, then \begin{equation*} \bM^\dagger=\bM^\top(\bM\bM^\top)^{-1}, \qquad \bM\bM^\dagger=\bI_r, \qquad \|\bM^\dagger\|_\op=\sigma_{\min}(\bM)^{-1}. \end{equation*} If $\bB\succeq\bZero$, then $\bB^\dagger\bB^2=\bB$.

results.name: Lemma A.4
results.title: Rectangular resolvent identities
results.manuscript_statement_tex: \label{lem:rectangular-resolvent-identities} Let $\bM\in\R^{r\times d}$ and $\eta>\|\bM\|_\op^2$. Then \begin{align*} (\eta\bI_d-\bM^\top\bM)^{-1}\bM^\top &= \bM^\top(\eta\bI_r-\bM\bM^\top)^{-1},\\ \bM(\eta\bI_d-\bM^\top\bM)^{-1} &= (\eta\bI_r-\bM\bM^\top)^{-1}\bM,\\ \bM^\top\bM(\eta\bI_d-\bM^\top\bM)^{-1} &= \bM^\top(\eta\bI_r-\bM\bM^\top)^{-1}\bM,\\ \eta(\eta\bI_d-\bM^\top\bM)^{-1} &= \bI_d+ \bM^\top(\eta\bI_r-\bM\bM^\top)^{-1}\bM. \end{align*}

results.name: Lemma A.5
results.title: Lipschitz continuity of the smallest singular value
results.manuscript_statement_tex: \label{lem:factor-perturbation} Let $\bS,\bar{\bS}\in\R^{r\times d}$. Then \begin{equation*} | \sigma_{\min}(\bar{\bS}) - \sigma_{\min}(\bS) | \leq \|\bar{\bS}-\bS\|_\op. \end{equation*}

results.name: Lemma A.6
results.title: Row-space projection perturbation
results.manuscript_statement_tex: \label{lem:sin-thm-variant} Let $\bM_0 \in \R^{r \times d}$ have full row rank, and let $\bM_1 = \bM_0 + \bDelta$ for some $\bDelta \in \R^{r \times d}$. Let $\bPi_0,\bPi_1 \in \R^{d \times d}$ denote orthogonal projections onto the row spaces of $\bM_0,\bM_1$, respectively. Then, \begin{equation*} \|(\bI_d - \bPi_0)\bPi_1\|_\Frob \leq \|(\bI_d - \bPi_1)\bPi_0\|_\Frob \leq \frac{\|\bDelta\|_\Frob}{\sigma_{\min}(\bM_0)}. \end{equation*}

results.name: Lemma A.7
results.title: Elementary scalar identities
results.manuscript_statement_tex: \label{lem:elementary-scalar-ineqs} For $a_1, \dots, a_k \geq 0$, \begin{equation*} \left(\sum_{i=1}^k a_i\right)^2 \leq k\sum_{i=1}^k a_i^2. \end{equation*} For $A,B\geq0$, \begin{equation*} \inf_{\delta>0}(A+\delta)\left(1+\frac{B}{\delta}\right) = (\sqrt A+\sqrt B)^2, \end{equation*} with optimizer $\delta=\sqrt{AB}$ when $AB>0$. Finally, for any norm $\|\cdot\|$, we have \begin{equation*} \inf_x \max\{\|x-x_0\|^2,\|x-x_1\|^2\} = \frac14\|x_0-x_1\|^2. \end{equation*}

results.name: Lemma A.8
results.title: Kronecker trace identity
results.manuscript_statement_tex: \label{lem:kronecker-fact} For matrices $\bA,\bB,\bC$ with dimensions such that the following products are well-defined, \begin{equation*} \tr(\bA\bC\bB\bC^\top) = \vec(\bC)^\top(\bB^\top\otimes\bA)\vec(\bC). \end{equation*}

results.name: Lemma B.1
results.title: Regression factor identities and regret formula
results.manuscript_statement_tex: \label{lem:regret-projection-formula} Let $\bSigma\in\PSD^d$, and fix any $\bS\in\R^{d\times r}$ such that $\bSigma=\bS\bS^\top$. Let $\bPi_X=\bS_X^\dagger\bS_X$ be the orthogonal projection onto the row space of $\bS_X$. Then \begin{equation*} \bA_\bSigma = \bSigma_{YX}\bSigma_X^\dagger = \bS_Y\bS_X^\dagger. \end{equation*} For the chosen factor $\bS$, the corresponding residual factor \[ \bE \defeq \bS_Y-\bA_\bSigma\bS_X = \bS_Y(\bI-\bPi_X) \] satisfies \begin{equation*} \bE \bS_X^\top=\bZero, \qquad \bE \bPi_X=\bZero, \qquad \bE \bE^\top=\bSigma_E. \end{equation*} Finally, for every $\bA \in \cA$, we have $L(\bA,\bSigma)=\|\bA\bS_X-\bS_Y\|_\Frob^2$ and \begin{equation*} R(\bA,\bSigma) = \|(\bS_Y-\bA\bS_X)\bPi_X\|_\Frob^2 = \|(\bA-\bA_\bSigma)\bS_X\|_\Frob^2. \end{equation*}

results.name: Lemma B.3
results.title: Bures continuity of the smallest feature eigenvalue
results.manuscript_statement_tex: \label{lem:Bures-lambda-min-continuity} For $\bSigma,\bar{\bSigma}\in\PSD^d$, we have \begin{equation*} \left| \sqrt{\lambda_{\min}(\smash{\bar{\bSigma}_X)}} - \sqrt{\lambda_{\min}(\bSigma_X)} \right| \leq \sB(\bar{\bSigma},\bSigma). \end{equation*} In particular, $\lambda_{\min}(\bSigma_X)$ is continuous with respect to the Bures metric.

results.name: Lemma C.1
results.title: Quadratic-ball duality
results.manuscript_statement_tex: \label{lem:quadratic-ball-duality} Let $\bM\in\R^{k\times d}$ and $\tilde{\bW}\in\R^{d\times r}$, where $k,r\geq1$. Set $b\defeq\|\bM\|_\op^2$. For every $\eta>b$, we have \begin{equation} \label{eq:quadratic-ball-envelope} \sup_{\bW\in\R^{d\times r}} \left\{ \|\bM\bW\|_\Frob^2 -\eta\|\bW-\tilde{\bW}\|_\Frob^2 \right\} = \eta\tr\left( (\eta\bI_k-\bM\bM^\top)^{-1} \bM\tilde{\bW}\tilde{\bW}^\top\bM^\top \right). \end{equation} Moreover, for every $t\in\R$, with $\sup\varnothing=-\infty$, we have \begin{equation} \label{eq:quadratic-ball-duality} \begin{aligned} \sup_{\substack{ \bW\in\R^{d\times r}\\ \|\bW-\tilde{\bW}\|_\Frob^2\leq t }} \|\bM\bW\|_\Frob^2 &= \sup_{\bW\in\R^{d\times r}} \inf_{\eta\geq0} \left\{ \|\bM\bW\|_\Frob^2 +\eta\bigl(t-\|\bW-\tilde{\bW}\|_\Frob^2\bigr) \right\}\\ &= \inf_{\eta\geq0} \sup_{\bW\in\R^{d\times r}} \left\{ \|\bM\bW\|_\Frob^2 +\eta\bigl(t-\|\bW-\tilde{\bW}\|_\Frob^2\bigr) \right\}\\ &= \inf_{\eta>b} \eta\left( t+ \tr\left( (\eta\bI_k-\bM\bM^\top)^{-1} \bM\tilde{\bW}\tilde{\bW}^\top\bM^\top \right) \right). \end{aligned} \end{equation}

results.name: Lemma C.2
results.title: Inner DRO strong duality
results.manuscript_statement_tex: \label{lem:inner-DRO-strong-duality} Let $P\in\cP_2(\R^d)$, $\eps > 0$, and $\bM\in\R^{k\times d}$ for $1\leq k\leq d$. Then \[ \sup_{Q\in\cB_\eps(P)}\E_Q\|\bM Z\|^2 = \inf_{\eta>\|\bM\|_\op^2} \eta\left( \eps^2+ \tr\left( (\eta\bI_k-\bM\bM^\top)^{-1} \bM\bSigma_P\bM^\top \right) \right). \] For regression, taking $k=m$ and $\bM=\bM_\bA$ gives \[ \sup_{Q\in\cB_\eps(P)}L(\bA,Q) = \inf_{\eta>1+\|\bA\|_\op^2} \eta\left( \eps^2+ \tr\left( ((\eta-1)\bI_m-\bA\bA^\top)^{-1} \bM_\bA\bSigma_P\bM_\bA^\top \right) \right). \]

results.name: Corollary C.3
results.title: Diagonal case
results.manuscript_statement_tex: \label{cor:DRO-strong-duality-diagonal} Let $P\in\cP_2(\R^d)$, $\eps > 0$, and $\bA\in\cA$ satisfy \[ \bA\bA^\top=\diag(a_1^2,\ldots,a_m^2). \] For $i=1,\ldots,m$, define the $i$th coordinate residual second moment \[ r_i^2 \defeq \E_P\bigl[(e_i^\top(\bA X-Y))^2\bigr] = e_i^\top\bM_\bA\bSigma_P\bM_\bA^\top e_i. \] We then have \[ \sup_{Q\in\cB_\eps(P)}L(\bA,Q) = \inf_{\eta>1+\max_i a_i^2} \eta\left( \eps^2+ \sum_{i=1}^m \frac{r_i^2}{\eta-1-a_i^2} \right). \]

results.name: Lemma C.4
results.title: Averaging over symmetries
results.manuscript_statement_tex: \label{lem:DRO-symmetry} Let $U$ be a compact subgroup of \[ \left\{ \diag(\bU_X,\bU_Y): \bU_X\in\OO^p,\ \bU_Y\in\OO^m \right\}. \] Suppose $P,\tilde{P} \in\cP_2(\R^d)$ satisfy $\bU_\sharp P=P$ and $\bU_\sharp \tilde{P}=\tilde{P}$ for every $\bU\in U$. Let $\eps > 0$, and fix any minimizer $\hat{\bA} \in \cA$ for the $\DRO_\eps[\tilde{P}]$, $\MRO_\eps[\tilde{P}]$, or $\SNR_\eps[\tilde{P}]$ optimization problem. Let $\mu$ be normalized Haar measure on $U$ and define \[ \bar{\bA} \defeq \int_U\bU_Y^\top\hat{\bA}\bU_X\,\dd\mu(\bU). \] Then $\bar{\bA}$ is a minimizer of the same optimization problem, is invariant in the sense that \[ \bU_Y^\top\bar{\bA}\bU_X=\bar{\bA} \qquad\forall\,\bU\in U, \] and satisfies $R(\bar{\bA},P)\leq R(\hat{\bA},P)$. Consequently, restricting any of these optimization problems to invariant coefficient matrices preserves its optimal value. Moreover, to lower bound the target regret of every optimizer, it suffices to lower bound the target regret of every invariant optimizer.

results.name: Lemma E.1
results.title: Parameter map derivative
results.manuscript_statement_tex: \label{lem:parameter-map-derivative} The map $g:\cC \to \cA$ is continuously differentiable, with \begin{equation*} D g(\bSigma)[\bH] = (\bH_{YX} - g(\bSigma) \bH_X) \bSigma_X^{-1} \quad \forall\, \bH \in \Sym^d. \end{equation*}

results.name: Lemma E.2
results.title: Derivative expression for $\tilde{\kappa}$
results.manuscript_statement_tex: \label{lem:alt-condition-number-formula} Fixing $\bSigma \in \cC^*$ with square root $\bS \defeq \bSigma^{1/2}$, we have \begin{equation} \label{eq:alt-condition-number-formula} \tilde{\kappa}(\bSigma) = \sup_{\bDelta \in \R^{d \times d}: \|\bDelta\|_\Frob \leq 1} \bigl\|D g(\bSigma)[\bS \bDelta^\top + \bDelta \bS] \bSigma_X^{1/2}\bigr\|_{\Frob}^2. \end{equation} Moreover, the expansion \begin{equation} \label{eq:alt-condition-number-taylor-expansion} \sup_{\bSigma' \in \cB_\eps(\bSigma)} R(g(\bSigma'),\bSigma) = \tilde{\kappa}(\bSigma) \eps^2 + o(\eps^2) \quad \eps \to 0 \end{equation} holds uniformly as $\bSigma$ varies in any compact subset of $\cC^*$.

results.manuscript_statement_tex: \label{lem:alt-condition-number-closed-form} For $\bSigma \in \cC^*$, we have \begin{equation*} \tilde{\kappa}(\bSigma) = 1 + \lambda_{\max}\left(\bA_\bSigma \bA_\bSigma^\top + \lambda_{\min}(\bSigma_X)^{-1}\bSigma_E\right). \end{equation*} In particular, we have \begin{equation*} 1 + \max\left\{\|\bA_\bSigma\|_\op^2, \frac{\lambda_{\max}(\bSigma_E)}{\lambda_{\min}(\bSigma_X)}\right\} \leq \tilde{\kappa}(\bSigma) \leq 1 + \|\bA_\bSigma\|_\op^2 + \frac{\lambda_{\max}(\bSigma_E)}{\lambda_{\min}(\bSigma_X)}. \end{equation*}

results.name: Lemma F.1

results.manuscript_statement_tex: \label{lem:regret-stability-refined} For all $\eps\geq0$, $\bA\in\cA$, $P\in\cP^*$, and $Q\in\cB_\eps(P)$, we have \begin{align*} \left| \sqrt{R(\bA,P)}-\sqrt{R(\bA,Q)} \right| \leq \left( \max\left\{ \|\bA-\bA_P\|_\op,\, \sqrt{1+\|\bA\|_\op^2}\, \right\} + \sqrt{ \frac{\lambda_{\max}(\bSigma_E^P)} {\lambda_{\min}(\bSigma_X^P)} } \,\right)\eps. \end{align*}

results.name: Lemma F.3
results.title: DRO strong duality
results.manuscript_statement_tex: \label{lem:DRO-minimax} Let $\eps \geq 0$. For all $P \in \cP^*$ and $\hat{P} \in \cB_\eps(P)$, we have \begin{equation*} \inf_{\bA \in \cA} \sup_{Q \in \cB_\eps(\hat{P})} L(\bA,Q) = \max_{Q \in \cB_\eps(\hat{P})} \inf_{\bA \in \cA} L(\bA,Q). \end{equation*} In particular, a maximizer exists for the right-hand side.

results.name: Lemma F.6
results.title: DRO regularizer bound
results.manuscript_statement_tex: \label{lem:DRO-regularizer} For $P\in\cP^*$, define \[ \Gamma_P \defeq \sqrt{\tr\bigl( (\bI_m+\bA_P\bA_P^\top)\bSigma_E^P \bigr)}. \] Then, for every $\eps\geq0$, \begin{equation} \label{eq:DRO-regularizer-intermediate} R_\eps(\DRO_\eps,P) \leq4\Gamma_P\eps+5\kappa_P\eps^2. \end{equation}

results.name: Lemma F.7
results.title: Rescaling invariance
results.manuscript_statement_tex: \label{lem:rescaling-invariance} Let $P,Q\in\cP_2(\R^d)$ and $\bA\in\cA$. For $\lambda>0$, let $P_\lambda$ and $Q_\lambda$ denote the pushforwards of $P$ and $Q$, respectively, under $z\mapsto\lambda z$. We then have \begin{align*} \Wtwo(P_\lambda,Q_\lambda) &=\lambda\Wtwo(P,Q),\\ L(\bA,P_\lambda)&=\lambda^2L(\bA,P),\\ R(\bA,P_\lambda)&=\lambda^2R(\bA,P),\\ \kappa_{P_\lambda}&=\kappa_P. \end{align*} Moreover, for $\eps\geq0$, $R^\star_{\lambda\eps}(P_\lambda) =\lambda^2R^\star_\eps(P)$, and the optimization problems defining $\DRO_{\lambda\eps}[P_\lambda]$ and $\DRO_\eps[P]$ have the same minimizer set.
